newsitem.title: USA: Control Data completes e-mail installation.
newsitem.headline: Control Data completes e-mail installation.

text.p: Control Data Systems Inc said Thursday it completed a project linking users of incompatible e-mail systems at the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA).
The value of the contract was not announced.

Control Data said it was able to connect about 14,000 users of several e-mail software programs through a single platform. The agency, which is responsible for predicting the weather and conserving the nation's marine and coastal resources, said the system will improve communications.
Control Data is a software and services provider.
Its shares closed off 7/16 Thursday at 13-5/8.
